newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged in listless trade.

text.p: A lack of market-inspiring news locked the Taiwan dollar in narrow trade on Monday and it closed unchanged from Saturday's finish. Dealers expected the rate to move narrowly against the U.S. dollar.

Dealers noted increasing month-end U.S. dollar commercial demand but said continued foreign equity fund inflows to the domestic stock market would offset the demand. "The market will be very dull in the near future, with all speculative players stepping to the sidelines," said one dealer.
The rate finished unchanged from Saturday's T$27.498. Turnover was US$127.5 million. -- Joyce Liu (2-5080815)
